transcript: Speaker A: मीना, यह एक्सपायरी डेट पढ़ के बता, यह दवाई दे सकते हैं या नहीं? [Meena, read this expiry date and tell me, can we give this medicine or not?] Speaker B: सर, EXP 06 2025. [Sir, EXP 06 2025.] Speaker A: जून 2025. मतलब एक्सपायर हो चुकी है। यह पेशेंट को देती तो? EXP मतलब एक्सपायरी, MFG मतलब मैन्युफैक्चरिंग। इतना बेसिक इंग्लिश नहीं आता तो तुझे गलती से रखा मैंने। [June 2025. Meaning it has expired. What if you gave this to a patient? EXP means expiry, MFG means manufacturing. If you don't know this basic English, I hired you by mistake.] Speaker B: सर, सीख लूंगी। [Sir, I will learn.] Speaker A: छह महीने हो गए बोल रही है सीख लूंगी। कब सीखेगी? [It's been six months and you keep saying you'll learn. When will you learn?] Speaker B: सर, एक मिनट देना मुझे। [Sir, give me a minute.] Speaker A: बोल। [Speak.] Speaker B: सर, this prescription says Tab Amoxicillin 500 mg, one tablet three times a day for five days. Syp Cetirizine 5 ml at bedtime for three days, and Cap Omeprazole 20 mg, one capsule before breakfast for seven days. Tab means tablet, Syp means syrup, Cap means capsules. Patient ko teen dawai deni hai: antibiotic, allergy ki, aur pet ki. [Sir, this prescription says Tab Amoxicillin 500 mg, one tablet three times a day for five days. Syp Cetirizine 5 ml at bedtime for three days, and Cap Omeprazole 20 mg, one capsule before breakfast for seven days. Tab means tablet, Syp means syrup, Cap means capsules. We need to give three medicines to the patient: antibiotic, for allergy, and for stomach.] Speaker A: मीना? [Meena?] Speaker B: सर, यह देखो। एक्सपायरी चेक करती हूं। Amoxicillin expiry 03/2027 valid. Cetirizine expiry 11/26 valid. Omeprazole expiry 08/26 valid. Teeno de sakti hoon. [Sir, look at this. I'll check the expiry. Amoxicillin expiry 03/2027 valid. Cetirizine expiry 11/26 valid. Omeprazole expiry 08/26 valid. I can give all three.] Speaker A: तूने यह कब सीखा? [When did you learn this?] Speaker B: सर, आपने तीन महीने पहले बोला था, गलती से रखा है तुझे। उस रात सोई नहीं। पर रोना नहीं चुना, सीखना चुना। [Sir, three months ago you said you hired me by mistake. I didn't sleep that night. But I chose not to cry, I chose to learn.] Speaker A: कैसे सीखी इतनी जल्दी? [How did you learn so quickly?] Speaker B: सर, English Seekho app download ki. General English show se start kiya. 'Hello se baat shuru karein' pehla video. 1,65,000 log dekh chuke the. Hindi mein samjhaya tha. Basic English seekhi: reading, speaking, understanding. [Sir, I downloaded the English Seekho app. Started with the General English show. 'Start conversation with Hello' was the first video. 1,65,000 people had watched it. It was explained in Hindi. Learnt basic English: reading, speaking, understanding.] Speaker A: पर प्रिस्क्रिप्शन पढ़ना तो अलग है ना? मेडिकल टर्म्स हैं उसमें। [But reading prescriptions is different, right? It has medical terms.] Speaker B: सर, AI Coach hai. 24 ghante available hai. Maine bola medical shop mein kaam karti hoon, prescription padhna hai. AI Coach ne ek-ek term sikha diya. Tab matlab tablet, Syp matlab syrup, Cap matlab capsule. OD matlab once a day, BD matlab twice a day, TDS matlab three times a day, HS matlab at bedtime, AC matlab before food, PC matlab after food. [Sir, there is an AI Coach. Available 24 hours. I said I work in a medical shop and need to read prescriptions. The AI Coach taught me every single term. Tab means tablet, Syp means syrup, Cap means capsule. OD means once a day, BD means twice a day, TDS means three times a day, HS means at bedtime, AC means before food, PC means after food.] Speaker A: और दवाई के नाम? [And medicine names?] Speaker B: सर, वो भी प्रैक्टिस की। Paracetamol bukhar ki, Amoxicillin antibiotic, Cetirizine allergy ki, Omeprazole acidity ki. Roz 10 prescription padh ke practice karti thi. AI Coach se check karwati thi. 500 baar galat padha, 500 baar sudhara. Kabhi nahi boli, medical background nahi hai, tujhse nahi hoga. [Sir, practiced those too. Paracetamol for fever, Amoxicillin antibiotic, Cetirizine for allergy, Omeprazole for acidity. Practiced by reading 10 prescriptions daily. Got them checked by AI Coach. Read wrong 500 times, corrected 500 times. It never said, you don't have a medical background, you can't do it.] Speaker A: मीना, आज से तू काउंटर पे बैठेगी। कस्टमर हैंडल करेगी। [Meena, from today you will sit at the counter. You will handle customers.] Speaker B: सर, थैंक यू। और सर, एक रिक्वेस्ट है। आपकी दूसरी ब्रांच में भी दो लड़कियां हैं, उन्हें भी इंग्लिश नहीं आती। अगर वो भी English Seekho app download karein, General English show se start karein, AI Coach se medical terms practice karein, toh ek mahine mein prescription padh lengi. Galat dawai dene ka risk nahi rahega, aapki dukan safe rahegi. Aur koi unhe galti se rakha nahi bolega. [Sir, thank you. And sir, one request. There are two girls in your other branch too, they also don't know English. If they also download the English Seekho app, start with the General English show, practice medical terms with the AI Coach, they will read prescriptions in a month. There won't be a risk of giving wrong medicine, your shop will be safe. And no one will tell them they were hired by mistake.] Speaker C: तो इंस्टॉल बटन पे क्लिक करो और English Seekho ऐप डाउनलोड करो। [So click on the install button and download the English Seekho app.]
